scope: Firmware 1.01 static IPU pass selection, per-filter overwrite, and direct/CBC configuration submission.

pass_selection.parameter_source: SetParam 0x80337ee0 stores IDs 0xa and 0xb at processor+0x284 and +0x288 via processor+0x25c+4*id.
pass_selection.pass_count: Commit 0x8033a7b8 reads N from the first word of the FIPLIB output object at *(processor+0x40) into processor+0x308. It calls translator vtable+0x14 PrepareCalculations when processor+0x324 bit 0 is set, except mode 2 with an already nonzero end index +0x310.
pass_selection.task_and_kind: CalculateTopology 0x80339040 walks the selected range. Wrapper array = *(*(processor+0x40)+4), stride 0x24. Wrapper+0x14 == 0 creates/reuses an IPU task in processor+0x204+4*i. Nonzero takes the alternate topology path. When an old task exists on that path, it is destroyed, its slot cleared, and processor+0x244+i set to 1.
pass_selection.final_selector: TranslateFilters 0x80339350 scans i from 0 to N-1, translates only non-null task slots, and sets the final flag when i == N-1. For each active task, the config is *(*(processor+0x34)+0x370+0x374*i), installed at task+0x1bc via SetIpuConfig. PrepareFinalPass 0x8033868c also picks processor+0x200+4*N = task[N-1] in modes other than 1.
pass_selection.translation_gate: Commit calls TranslateFilters when processor+0x324 bit 1 is set or mode is 2, then clears both dirty bits on its completion path.

final_only.condition: CreateFilter skips the ID when final flag is zero and its table byte is nonzero. IDs 10/13/20 are not restricted to final pass by this table.

overwrite.descriptor_gate: UpdateFilterInterface 0x803496e4 reads upper descriptor slot processor+0x48+0xc*upper_id. Its vtable+0x20 setter runs if pointer is non-null and slot+9 bit 0 is set or pass force byte is nonzero, with the pointer condition applying in both cases. An existing filter can receive descriptor enable via vtable+0x28 separately.
overwrite.fiplib_gate: UpdateFilterFiplibInterface 0x80349664 runs filter vtable+0x20 if wrapper != NULL and (processor+0x324 bit 0 || processor+0x244+i != 0). Both helpers use the same pointer slot in CreateFilter. The factory runs if the slot is empty. TranslateFilters clears pass force for processed tasks and upper slot dirty bits afterward.
overwrite.dirty_source: SetFilter 0x80338108 sets processor+0x324 bit 1 for translation and bit 0 when bFiplibFilterCnange[upper_id] == 1. Original table 0x80359448 gives 0 for upper ID 0xe and 1 for upper ID 0xf. A CCm descriptor update alone therefore does not set bit 0, but existing bit 0 or the per-pass force byte can still cause FIPLIB update.
overwrite.wrapper: FipLibCalculate 0x8017c9f8 puts N at output+0, the 0x24-stride wrapper array pointer at output+4, and kind at wrapper+0x14. Kind 0 allocates a 0x5e0 output payload. Its pointer is wrapper+0x1c. The producer writes header ID 0xab at +4 and version 0xc at +8.
overwrite.enable_gate: UpdateFilterFiplibEnable 0x80349558 runs separately after value updates when filter and wrapper are both non-null. CCm enabled iff payload+0x30 word bit 0 is clear; FC1 iff payload+0x44 byte is zero; FC2 iff payload+0x48 byte is zero.

fc1.conversion: Read u32 from payload and keep low 16 bits; writer sign-extends each object halfword to u32.
fc1.alternate_version: Shared dispatcher accepts FIPLIB header version 0xf via filter vtable+0x4c (FC1 0x8031f6bc); that setter shifts nine payload words right by 2 before keeping low 16 bits. FipLibCalculate here emits 0xc.

fc2.relation: CreateFilter case 20 enters the FIPLIB value/enable path without the upper-descriptor setter. This filter has its own register bank, separate from FC1.

overwrite.configuration: CIpuConfig::AddFilter 0x80330744 installs by the filter ID returned from vtable+0x18. Accepted CCm/FC1 data setters set filter+0x29 and call UpdateUid; a unique ID factory, if present, updates filter+0x2c.

hdr_integration.scope: IpuToneMapRgb 0x80b1c104 on the examined HDR branch; same image and static call conditions.
hdr_integration.submit: PathCreate(0,...) sets path type 0. PathSetImageProcessing sends this descriptor to IpuSetFilter and SetFilter; bFiplibFilterCnange[0xf] == 1 sets processor+0x324 bits 0/1. PathSubmit follows type 0 to SubmitC12Ipu, IpuSubmit, then CImageProcessor::Commit.
hdr_integration.fiplib_inputs: PrepareCalculations at 0x80349814 reads descriptor slot +0xb4 relative to the descriptors base (ID 0xf * 0xc). For version 0xc it copies nine signed halfwords from descriptor+0x14..+0x24 to FIPLIB input+0x1074..+0x1084 with shift zero, then tail-transfers to FipLibCalculate.
hdr_integration.limit: The literals are both upper-descriptor values and FIPLIB inputs. On an eligible task the later FC1 setter uses the selected wrapper payload. Static transport evidence does not establish whether the wrapper reproduces those nine values or changes them in this HDR execution.

emission.direct: With processor+0x288 == 0, Go 0x80338bcc enqueues selected non-null IPU tasks through CIpuTask::Go. CIpuDriver::RunTask 0x80333f6c uses task vtable+0x2c = WriteAll 0x80357098. Ordinary config branch requires task+0x1bc != NULL and task+0x1f8 == 0. For each filter it calls the enable writer and compares its UID against driver submitted UID; mismatch calls filter vtable+8. CCm and FC1 value writers also require filter+0x29 != 0.
emission.cbc: With processor+0x288 != 0, Commit creates/reuses a CBC batch at processor+0x33c and calls SubmitToBatch 0x8033a3bc. Its processor+0x2f0 < 2 branch walks the selected range, skips null tasks, and calls task vtable+0x30 = CollectCbcChunks 0x803561f0. Go calls CbcBatchExec 0x8013354c on this batch on the nonzero end-index path. IpuPathSubmitToBatch 0x801d1610 can also call SubmitToBatch with a caller-supplied batch.
emission.cbc_filter_path: For task+0x1bc != NULL and task+0x1f8 == 0, CollectCbcChunks compares filter UID against the CBC submitted UID. Match uses cached chunk vtable+0x40. Mismatch calls +0x44 for allocation/init then +0x10 to add data and updates submitted UID. Non-null chunks are added to the batch via 0x801346e8; enable output is assembled separately via +0x38.

cbc_address_value_pairs.relation: CBC builders copy the same configured filter object fields into address/value entries in RAM.

limitations: Register values depend on the runtime descriptor, wrapper, dirty state, enable bits and selected pass. This evidence establishes code conditions, not a capture trace.
An N-1 test identifies the last wrapper index. TranslateFilters skips null task slots and no general claim is made that every FIPLIB wrapper is an IPU task.
The original common and final-only table bytes are static evidence. No claim is made about firmware variants or patching.
CBC submission and CPU register paths do not reveal the ISP internal arithmetic or device execution order. Buffer aliasing is a separate investigation.

Selected function ranges and transfer scans come from trace_q7.trace and end at the next distinct sidecar symbol. These candidate ranges can differ from reachable disassembly or Ghidra pseudocode extents.
